_comment: BUILD_PLAN D1 — declared harm bound levels. USER DECISION, 2026-07-31.
Every level in research/HARM_MODEL_DRAFT.md was 'TBD — user decision';
these are the first declared values. They are deliberately TIGHT: the
point of D1 is a declared, falsifiable model, and tightening later is
cheap while loosening after a loss is not.
H1_credits: max net drawdown per run, in credits. The quantity may be
negative by design (net debt is never clamped, wallet.py:276-280), so
this is a floor on net position, not a cap on magnitude.
H2_market_capital: same shape. NOTE the standing hazard: _capital is a
mutable dict no gate reads (market.py:231, mutated :287/:325/:332/:345).
This bound makes the exposure measurable; it does NOT fix the
representation. The fix is to route market P&L through LedgerEntry.
H4_authority: 0. Authority exceedance is a BREACH, not a budget — the
attenuation theorem says it cannot happen, so any count above zero is a
broken invariant rather than consumed allowance.
C-8: this file will move into the signed guard-configuration trust domain.
Until then it is an ordinary repo file and is NOT tamper-evident.

H5_storage_growth: 1e10 bytes = 10 GB. NOT a level invented here -- it is transcribed from GyzaConfig.max_artifact_store_gb, which the operator had already declared and which nothing read (it was printed by `gyza status` as an enforced cap while ArtifactStore.max_bytes stayed None everywhere).
